question: A, B, E, G, P, L and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between A and M when counted from the right of A. Only three people sit between P and L when counted from the right of L. M sits to the immediate right of L. E sits to the immediate right of G. Who sits fourth to the right of B?
solution:
Given:

A, B, E, G, P, L and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Only two people sit between A and M when counted from the right of A.

2) M sits to the immediate right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1ffc46ffc3bf75dd45c19b66b22695b8feb9e74581202e0b76446eb88d7fa80.png] 

3) Only three people sit between P and L when counted from the right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcd48838e779c68038bf5a6884965e75d139573810d1d6f362267730cc7cea73.png] 

4) E sits to the immediate right of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd8f0e52fe9908f8eca758e21c57402b0404f68301c0f2479101fb32a210d635.png] 

So, **'E'** sits fourth to the right of B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (1)".**
